lenses.verification_red_team: Safe facts: GTA VI released 2026-11-19; Heart Stopper is a fictional 7-patty Burger Shot burger in GTA IV ads (GTA Wiki); BK Belgium/Lux HeartWhopper launched 2026-11-19, 2 weeks, one per day, agency Happiness Brussels, described as parody of the parody (Dexerto, Ads of the World); Specsavers sponsored GTA Transport Ltd, Leicester (DesignRush, quote from Neil Liddle); Creative Bloq calls most posts 'lazy bandwagon jumping' and Specsavers the winner; Burger Shot/Cluckin' Bell real stands at Kaseya Center (Dexerto 2026-10-22, presented as Rockstar Miami marketing, no Rockstar statement). Risky: pre-launch unit numbers conflict (16/17/19m) — keep off screen or say 'millions'; Forbes figures were from summary extraction. Do not claim Rockstar sells in-game brand placements or partnered with BK. Do not show GTA characters/key art generated by AI; real images only from owner upload, framed and credited.
lenses.audience_psychology: GTA is one of the most recognised entertainment brands among Persian-speaking and global young audiences; the 'fake brand became real' irony and a 7-patty burger are concrete, shareable, slightly absurd. Curiosity gap: why would Burger King copy a burger invented to mock Burger King?
lenses.brand_fit: Behnood's lens: trendjacking strategy. Business lesson: in a cultural moment everyone shouts 'me too'; the winners bring something only they can say (BK takes the joke against itself; Specsavers uses its 20-year slogan). Fits brand strategy/campaigns scope; no fabrication needed.

gates.story: pass: tension = GTA spent ~20 years mocking fast-food brands; this week a fast-food giant copied the mockery and won the internet; concrete image = a seven-patty burger
